planets.name: WASP-38 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-38 with a 6.87-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-38 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-38. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 6.8718851, pl_radj 1.23, pl_bmassj 3.44

quotes.title: HD 146389
quotes.card: The star is known to host one exoplanet, designated WASP-38b or formally named Iztok.
